module_summary: 8-bit ripple-carry adder built from two chained add4 instances, the low nibble's carry Co_temp feeding the high nibble.

anchors.name: a
anchors.why: 8-bit operand A, split into low and high nibbles for the two add4 children.

anchors.name: b
anchors.why: 8-bit operand B, split into low and high nibbles for the two add4 children.

anchors.name: y
anchors.why: 8-bit sum assembled from both add4 children's 4-bit results.

anchors.name: Co_temp
anchors.why: Ripple carry from low add4 into the high add4's carry-in.

anchors.name: Co
anchors.why: Final carry-out produced by the high add4 instance.

groups.name: ripple_adder_chain
groups.description: Two add4 blocks chained low-to-high through Co_temp, producing 8-bit sum and carry-out.
